cluster_id.description: REQUIRED — BYOC resource pool ID (from list_clusters) to deploy this graph project onto your own cluster. Owned hosting is retired: a project we operate must run on your own infrastructure. Register a pool via the Resource Pools UI first, then pass its id here.
